name: my-git
description: Customized git workflow for Claude: the git-guard hooks (git identity, Conventional Commits without AI co-authors, safe gh usage, main + develop/base branching model with PR-only protected branches) plus /my-git:commit, /my-git:push and /my-git:pr skills and a reusable repo template (PR template, git hooks, GitHub ruleset). Works with a pinned SSH key or, for a single GitHub account, with HTTPS through the gh credential helper.
